name: contact-hub
purpose: The band under the Contact title band: the team lanes side by side (Sales and Support), each with its scope in one sentence and the action that reaches that team, over a row of self-serve channels. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'contact-hub', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `registration-frame`, `card-grid`, `feature-item`, `button` and `status-indicator`. Lanes and channels share one frame, the channels in the rows under the lanes. A lane can carry a second button and a link to the system status page, so a reader can check for an incident before opening a ticket.
useWhen: On the Contact page, to route a reader to the team or channel that answers them.
avoidWhen: For a closing ask at the end of a page → use `closing-call-to-action`.
For a grid of product use cases → use `customer-use-cases`.
related: `feature-item` — each self-serve channel is a linked topic.
`customer-use-cases` — the sibling band of icon-led topics.
bestPractices: Give it as many lanes and channels as the page has: both rows balance themselves (`card-grid` `layout: 'balanced'`), so two channels split the row in halves, three in thirds, four into 2 × 2 and five into 3 + 2, with no empty cell.
Don't pad `channels` to three or drop one to make the row fit.
Keep each lane's description to one sentence that states what that team handles.
Set `target: '_blank'` on a channel or status link that leaves the site.
Lead each lane with its `action`; add a `secondaryAction` only for a second route to the same team (an outlined button after the first).
Give the band an `anchor` when a page links to it with a `#hash`.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.

props.name: lanes
props.doc: The team lanes side by side, in order; each is `{ icon, title, description, action?, secondaryAction?, statusLink? }` where `action` is the lane's leading button, `secondaryAction` an outlined button after it, and `statusLink` the system status link beside them.

props.name: channels
props.doc: The self-serve channels in the rows under the lanes, in order; each is `{ icon, title, description, href, target? }`, rendered as a linked topic.
